case_name: HMG-99999-11 — Victor Bushell: CCleaner wipe + pre-flight escape (Dover-Calais-Hamburg)
description: Victor Bushell laptop (Windows 7) acquired 2011-10-23 by examiner Craig Wilson (CUC/1). NTFS volume shows zero user files in allocated space — CCleaner wipe executed. IE browser cache in unallocated sectors reveals 24-hour activity window (2011-10-18 to 2011-10-19): CCleaner 3.11 downloaded, InPrivate browsing researched, P&O Ferries booking completed (foot passenger, Dover-Calais), Google Maps route to Osterbrook Hamburg, Deutsche Bank Money Transfer accessed, Gmail accessed. Five-signal pre-flight evidence-destruction and asset-transfer cluster 4 days before seizure.

peirce_chain.firstness: NTFS fls shows zero user files in allocated space. IE browser cache in unallocated: CCleaner 3.11 downloaded (fs31.filehippo.com), How-to-Use-CCleaner.pdf on Desktop, Bing 'ccleaner filetype:pdf', InPrivate browsing research, P&O Ferries Steps 1-2-3, 'dover to calais foot passenger', Google Maps Calais→Osterbrook Hamburg, Deutsche Bank Money Transfer, Gmail. Activity: 2011-10-18T15:23:23 to 2011-10-19T15:23:26.
peirce_chain.secondness: Normal Windows 7 after use has extensive AppData and user files. Completely empty NTFS is physically impossible without deliberate wipe. Foot passenger search (not generic 'ferry') specifically avoids vehicle manifest recording. Deutsche Bank Money Transfer (not home banking) accessed same day as Hamburg route planning. All five signals within 24h window, 4 days before seizure.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Pre-flight anti-forensic pattern: research→download→study→execute CCleaner (wipe evidence), then plan anonymous foot-passenger ferry to Hamburg (avoid vehicle ID), transfer assets to Deutsche Bank (destination country). Carnegie: concealment — erasure of digital substrate, physical identity minimization, financial pre-positioning.

devil_advocate: Routine PC maintenance (CCleaner), vacation to Hamburg (ferry), legitimate Deutsche Bank account. Empty NTFS could be clean install. Foot passenger cheaper than vehicle. Istanbul route unrelated query.

artifacts.description: NTFS volume (ewf1) fls -r shows zero user files in allocated space. Only NTFS metadata structures present ($MFT, $LogFile, $Bitmap, $Volume, $Extend). Consistent with CCleaner full wipe of user partition prior to seizure.

IE browser cache (unallocated sectors): Bing search 'ccleaner filetype:pdf', CCleaner 3.11 download URL fs31.filehippo.com/4145/3d5912a1b2b245179e5d27b059c4eed7/ccsetup311.exe, desktop files 'How to Use CCleaner.pdf' and 'CCleaner_Disk_File_Cleanup.pdf', InPrivate browsing page cached. Timestamp 2011-10-18T15:23:23.

IE cache (unallocated): P&O Ferries Book Journey Steps 1-2-3 (complete booking flow), Bing 'dover to calais foot passenger', Bing 'sealink ferry time dover to calais', timetable downloaded. Google Maps Calais (50.872004,1.58466) to Osterbrook Hamburg (53.54612,10.053067). Bing 'google maps istanbul to hamburg'. Timestamp 2011-10-19T15:23:26.

IE cache (unallocated): Deutsche Bank Home, Disclaimer, Money Transfer, Online Money Transfers pages cached. Access contemporaneous with Hamburg route planning. Indicates asset transfer to destination-country bank.

metadata.transfer_amount: UNKNOWN (only page titles recovered, not form data)

caie_fractures.description: CCleaner wipe (F-001) + foot passenger ferry (F-002) + Deutsche Bank transfer (F-003) all occur within 24h window, 4 days pre-seizure. Three independent anti-forensic/evasion signals converging on a single timeline.
